identity.title: Probability Inequalities for Sums of Bounded Random Variables
identity.venue: Journal of the American Statistical Association

read_extent: Original printed pp14-16 visually inspected. Theorem2/Eq2.6 used; independent-two-sample corollary not used. This ASCII directed transcript is not OCR/fulltext.
claim: Hoeffding gives a concentration inequality for sums of independent random variables with possibly different bounded ranges. We apply it to weighted paired-root differences, with the root-independence and fixed-design assumptions stated explicitly.
limits: Directed source reading only, no formal measurements or unconditional cross-root dependence guarantee. Independent review pending.
